privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.subtitle: Commitment to Privacy by Design • Last updated: September 10, 2026
privacy.badge_no_accounts_desc: We never ask for emails, names, passwords, or payment info to use the app.
privacy.badge_camera_ram_desc: Frames are processed locally and destroyed instantly. Zero photos or videos stored.
privacy.badge_no_gps_desc: We never track, request, or store your geographic location.
privacy.s0_title: 0. Express Acceptance by Installation, Access, and Use
privacy.s0_p1: By downloading, installing, accessing, scanning, or otherwise using the PassQ application, the user freely, voluntarily, and knowingly declares full and unreserved acceptance of this Privacy Policy, data sovereignty principles, and local-only technical processing architecture.
privacy.s1_title: 1. Fundamental Principle: Zero Data Collection & No Accounts
privacy.s1_p1: At PassQ Technologies Ltd., we engineer software with the highest standard of user sovereignty. We do not collect, store in the cloud, sell, or transfer any personal data.
privacy.s1_p2: To use PassQ and generate Digital Product Passports (DPP) or scan GS1 QR codes, the user does NOT need to create an account or provide email, name, phone number, or payment details.
privacy.s2_p1: The application requests access to the optical camera sensor solely and exclusively when the user voluntarily clicks the scan button.
privacy.s2_li1: Local RAM Processing: Every frame captured by the sensor is analyzed in real time inside temporary device RAM using native optical decoding APIs.
privacy.s2_li2: Zero Storage & Zero Cloud Upload: No image, screenshot, photo, or video is saved to permanent storage or transmitted over the internet to any server. When the scanner is closed or the tab is suspended, the camera stream is halted and memory is instantly released.
privacy.s2_li3: No Background Access: PassQ never accesses the camera, microphone, or any sensors in the background.
privacy.s3_p1: PassQ does not request, access, log, or process GPS geolocation coordinates, cell tower data, or Wi-Fi identifiers. The application operates with total anonymity regardless of where you are located.
privacy.s4_p1: All product passports, drafts, material compositions, repair manuals, and custom settings are stored exclusively inside your browser's local databases (LocalStorage and IndexedDB).
privacy.s4_p2: PassQ maintains no central databases containing user catalogs. Data sovereignty and custody belong 100% to the user on their own hardware.
privacy.s5_title: 5. Right to Immediate & Permanent Erasure (GDPR & Apple Guideline 5.1.1(v))
privacy.s5_p1: In compliance with strict European Union GDPR guidelines and Apple App Store / Google Play Store policies, the application includes a direct 'Hard Delete' button in the dashboard.
privacy.s5_p2: Triggering this button instantly and irreversibly purges all local product records, cryptographic keys, and cached data, resetting the application to a pristine state.
privacy.s6_title: 6. Zero Third-Party Tracking Cookies or Invasive Telemetry
privacy.s6_p1: We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site trackers, or invasive third-party analytics. All application logic runs entirely on your device.
privacy.s7_p1: For inquiries or requests regarding this privacy policy, you may contact our compliance team:

terms.s7_title: 7. Dispute Resolution, Binding Arbitration, and Class Action Waiver
terms.s7_p1: Any controversy, claim, dispute, or lawsuit arising out of or related to PassQ, its services, digital passports, or these Terms shall be resolved exclusively and individually through binding commercial arbitration, waiving any right to ordinary court trials.
terms.s7_alert_desc: You and PassQ agree that any dispute resolution proceedings will be conducted solely on an individual basis and not in a class, consolidated, or representative action.
terms.s8_title: 8. 7-Day Free Trial Period and SaaS Subscription Conditions
terms.s8_p1: PassQ grants new brands and SMEs a 7-day calendar trial period with full, unrestricted access to all Pro features (Web Crypto signing, LCA carbon footprint, customs export, and GS1 Mod 10 QR generator).
terms.s8_li1: No hidden fees and no mandatory upfront credit card required to start the trial.
terms.s8_li2: Service Continuity: After the 7-day trial, users may subscribe to active tiers ($19.99, $39.99, or $99.99 USD/mo) or keep their locally saved passports.
terms.s8_li3: Data Sovereignty: All data created during the trial belongs solely to the user and is stored locally in the browser.

terms.s1_alert_desc: PassQ provides operational and technical software support. PassQ DOES NOT provide legal counsel, sworn certifications, or binding customs rulings. This tool does not replace formal audits, legal declarations, or official requirements mandated by individual national authorities.

terms.s2_exemption: PassQ, its creators, developers, and affiliates are completely exempt from any legal, civil, commercial, customs, or administrative liability arising from legislative amendments, regulatory discrepancies between nations, customs seizures, administrative fines, or government penalties imposed upon the user.

compliance.title: Regulatory Compliance Statement
compliance.subtitle: EU Regulation 2024/1781 (ESPR), GS1 Digital Link & Right to Repair
compliance.s0_p1: By utilizing the application, the user acknowledges that generated passports serve as technical interoperability support, and that the accuracy and legal conformity of reported data remain the non-delegable duty of the manufacturer or importer.
compliance.s1_p1: PassQ is engineered according to the technical directives of the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR), supporting circular economy metrics, material composition transparency, and product longevity.
compliance.s2_p1: All emitted passports utilize the standard GS1 Digital Link URI schema (ISO/IEC 15459), ensuring universal compatibility with POS retail scanners, mobile cameras, and customs verification systems.
compliance.s3_p1: PassQ integrates repairability scoring frameworks, enabling manufacturers to document repair timeframes, required tools, and certified spare parts catalogs.
compliance.disclaimer_p1: PassQ provides data structuring software and infrastructure. The legal obligation to verify local legal conformity rests exclusively on the manufacturer or importer. Customs authorities retain ultimate discretion over goods clearance.

security.title: Security & Cryptographic Architecture
security.subtitle: ed25519 Asymmetric Digital Signatures & Local Verification
security.s1_p1: Every passport emitted via PassQ features an ed25519 asymmetric cryptographic signature generated with the manufacturer's private key, preventing tampering during customs audits.
security.s2_p1: If you are a security researcher who has identified a vulnerability, please report responsibly to: passq-reportes@outlook.com
